description: Write or correct what a photo or video shows. Use it to fix a summary, to fill in one marked needs_summary (older photos and browser captures have none), or after a person edits the words. Each change keeps the earlier wording. Workers on the shop can edit; the summary is never shown to customers.

edited_by_person.description: True when a person wrote or changed these words, not your model

summary.description: What you saw in the file. Look at the photo or watch the video before you upload it. Send either summary (with generated_by) or unable_to_analyze, never both.

duration_seconds.description: Video only and required for video: length in seconds, at most 600.

generated_by.description: Which agent or model wrote this, such as your product name. Required with summary.

key_moments.description: Video only: the moments that matter.

language.description: Language of the transcript, such as en or es

measurements.description: Sizes and readings. Say whether you read it off a tape or gauge, or estimated it.

unit.description: Unit, such as in, ft, psi, F

text.description: What and where, in a sentence

readable_text.description: Text you could read: model and serial plates, labels, gauges, signs. Copy it exactly.

what.description: What it is, such as model number or serial number

summary.description: Plain words a worker can read later: what the photo or video shows, where, and its condition. 1 to 4000 characters.

transcript.description: Video only: what was said, as words. Leave out if nobody spoke.

unable_to_analyze.description: Send this instead of summary when you cannot look at the file. The upload still goes through and the media is listed by media.needsSummary until someone summarizes it.

name: media_setSummary
